title: Houma Hunter Lime Perfect Collection
native_title: 宝魔ハンター ライム Ｐｅｒｆｅｃｔ Ｃｏｌｌｅｃｔｉｏｎ
overview:
Houma Hunter Lime Perfect Collection gathers the first eight episodes of the Houma Hunter Lime digital animation adventure series on two discs. Once a month a door behind the full moon opens between the human world and the magical world. On one such night the winged demon girl Lime and her shape-shifting partner Bass chase a demon who has stolen six power gems through the door, and now they must blend in among humans and hunt down the gems scattered across Tokyo, running into odd monsters born from everyday objects along the way. Each episode plays out as an animated story: choose simple commands from the menu to move the scene along, and watch Lime's comic misadventures unfold.

- Episodes 1 to 8 of the series
- Single player
- Memory backup save
- Two discs
- Rated for ages 18 and over
